cards.hearing: You may hear that the tariffs on goods from other countries are being challenged in court.
cards.why: Tariffs can change what it costs to bring in things like clothes, electronics, or parts for the car in the garage, so a court fight over them can feel like it touches the family budget.
cards.but: But court cases move slowly, and no one can say today how a judge will rule or what it will mean for prices down the road.
cards.story: Picture a referee reviewing a close call while the game keeps going. Fans in the stands still watch, still cheer, still plan for next season, even before the review is final.
say: We let the courts sort out the tariff case. Your plan does not wait on a ruling.
One legal review does not change how we invest for your goals.

cards.hearing: You may hear that interest rates on longer-term borrowing ticked up today, even though inflation news came in a little softer than expected.
cards.why: Those rates help set things like mortgage costs and car loan costs, so when they drift up, monthly payments can drift up too.
cards.but: But rates move up and down often, and a plan built for years, not days, does not need to react to one day's move.
cards.story: Think of a homeowner who refinanced last year and now sees a headline that rates ticked up again. They do not tear up their loan. They just keep making the payment they already locked in.
say: Rates wiggled today. Your plan already expects wiggles.
We watch rates, but we do not chase every move in them.

cards.hearing: You may hear that stocks had a mixed day today, some parts up, some parts down, and nothing dramatic either way.
cards.why: Days like this remind us that markets are not one big machine moving together, some areas lead while others lag.
cards.but: But a quiet, mixed day is actually pretty normal, and normal days are what long-term investing is built on.
cards.story: Picture a garden with different plants growing at different speeds. Some days one section looks better than another, but you do not rip out the whole garden over one afternoon.
say: Nothing alarming here, just markets doing their normal thing.
This is the kind of day that does not change your plan at all.
